key_claims: Al-Mihdhar held a US visa and entered the US on 15 January 2000, departing 10 June 2000.
A CIA analyst only discovered this in August 2001 while reviewing cables.
Another correspondent notes a shared passport number and that his fellow travelers also made US trips in January.
The analyst proposed passing the information to the FBI ahead of discussing the USS Cole.
